page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.large is a general-purpose virtual server configured on the x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor. The compute subsystem is equipped with 2 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 8.0 GB, yielding 4.0 GB of memory per core. This 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio positions the instance within the standard general-purpose tier, providing balanced resources for operational footprints that do not require specialized high-density memory arrays or high core counts.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, meaning all persistent data and operating system boot volumes require network-attached cloud disks. Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 2 Gbps, managed across virtualized interfaces without complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. The omission of local NVMe storage simplifies stateless compute lifecycles and horizontal scaling, though all input-output operations remain bound to external network block storage performance.

With dedicated vCPUs, the hardware profile avoids the performance unpredictability common to shared-core or burstable instances. The lack of hardware GPU acceleration and local drive arrays keeps the deployment focused strictly on standard general-purpose tasks. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.large fits workloads such as small-to-medium web serving, containerized microservices, development and test environments, background task workers, and lightweight backend services.
